level.title: Macedonian A1 Starter: Children 5-10, playful visuals, alphabet, greetings
level.description: Complete Macedonian A1 course for Starter. Children 5-10, playful visuals, alphabet, greetings. Includes 8 lessons, 20-30 study hours, visual learning with child characters, country context from MK, dotted tracing, and cultural themes.
goals: Master A1 level Macedonian for starter
Learn 96 new words about daily life in Macedonian-speaking countries
Practice with visual aids: child characters, country flags, cultural motifs
Complete 10 test questions and dotted tracing worksheets
